### Supporting basis

The query targets a specific customer within a narrow time window, retrieving all columns. A composite index on (customer_id, created_at) is highly efficient here. It first filters rows by exact customer_id match, significantly reducing the search space from 10 million to roughly 200 rows. Because the index is sorted by created_at within each customer, the database can efficiently seek only the rows falling within the seven-day interval, avoiding scanning the entire customer history.

In contrast, separate indexes force the database to use only one index per query. If it uses customer_id, it retrieves ~200 row pointers but must fetch all historical orders for that customer from the table to filter by date, causing excessive random I/O. If it uses created_at, it scans 200,000+ rows across all customers, which is prohibitively expensive. The composite index leverages both conditions simultaneously, minimizing disk access and leveraging index ordering for range scans, which is critical for performance on this scale.

### Recommendation

Choose the single composite B-tree index on (customer_id, created_at). This structure aligns perfectly with the query pattern, enabling efficient index-only filtering for the seven-day range without touching the heap table for unnecessary rows. Separate indexes cannot handle the multi-condition filtering efficiently, leading to significant performance degradation due to full table scans or inefficient index intersections.

This approach ensures low latency for read operations, as the database directly locates the precise subset of data via the index leaf nodes. It also minimizes lock contention and memory overhead compared to maintaining two separate index structures. Given the static, read-only nature of the data, this index remains optimal without the maintenance overhead of updates. For maximum efficiency, ensure the index is built with appropriate storage parameters to handle the large dataset, but the column order (customer_id first) is crucial for optimal query planning.<|im_end|>
